title: Occupancy, Party Size and Per-Traveller Pricing Across the Vacation Package Products
content:
Every one of the Vacation Package Products publishes its own party limits and its own per-traveller pricing bases. The published figures are the smallest party the product may be sold to, the largest party one package may carry before group terms apply, the number of travellers from which the group desk takes the booking instead, the number of paying travellers that earns one free place on a group booking, the supplement charged to a traveller occupying a room or cabin alone as a percentage of the per-person price, the discount for a third adult sharing a room or cabin, the age up to and including which a traveller is charged as a child together with that child discount, and the age under which an infant travels at the flat infant price together with that price.

## Party limits

| Product | Minimum party | Maximum party on one package | Group desk takes the booking from | Paying travellers earning one free place |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Value Bundle Package | 1 | 6 | 7 | none published (0) |
| Flex Bundle Package | 1 | 8 | 9 | none published (0) |
| All-Inclusive Resort Package | 2 | 8 | 9 | none published (0) |
| Escorted Tour Package | 1 | 12 | 13 | 20 |
| Ocean Cruise Package | 2 | 10 | 11 | 16 |
| Luxury Collection Package | 2 | 8 | 9 | none published (0) |

## Per-traveller pricing bases

| Product | Single supplement | Third-adult discount | Child age limit | Child discount | Infant age limit | Infant price |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Value Bundle Package | 65 per cent | 10 per cent | 11 | 15 per cent | 2 | 99.00 USD |
| Flex Bundle Package | 55 per cent | 12 per cent | 11 | 20 per cent | 2 | 99.00 USD |
| All-Inclusive Resort Package | 50 per cent | 15 per cent | 12 | 35 per cent | 2 | 149.00 USD |
| Escorted Tour Package | 45 per cent | 10 per cent | 15 | 25 per cent | 2 | 149.00 USD |
| Ocean Cruise Package | 75 per cent | 8 per cent | 12 | 20 per cent | 2 | 199.00 USD |
| Luxury Collection Package | 40 per cent | 20 per cent | 12 | 30 per cent | 2 | 199.00 USD |

## Points of judgement on the figures

The single supplement is expressed as a percentage of the per-person price and is the only one of these bases that adds to a traveller's price; the third-adult and child figures are discounts on the same per-person price. The child age limit is inclusive: on the Escorted Tour Package a traveller aged 15 is still within the child age, and on the Value Bundle Package and the Flex Bundle Package the child age runs only to 11. The infant age limit is exclusive and stands at 2 on all six products, the flat infant price rising from 99.00 USD to 199.00 USD across them.

A free-place figure of nil against a product means that product publishes no free place at all; only the Escorted Tour Package, at 20 paying travellers, and the Ocean Cruise Package, at 16, publish one.
